name: Spells
description:
Reworked spells:

1) Protection from Water/Fire/Earth/Air Magic - at expert level 75% reduction of damage is granted.
2) Armageddon - damage multiplier is decreased to 40xSP
3) Summon Fire / Earth Elemental - number of summoned creatures at expert level is 3xSP for Fire and 2xSP for Earth Elemental.
4) Slow - at advanced and expert level it reduces speed to 50% + 1.
5) Earthquake - at expert level 5 targets can be hit with increased chance for critical hit.
6) Fireball, Frost Ring and Inferno - damage multiplier increased to 15xSP.
7) Fire Shield - at expert level it is a mass spell with effect equal to 25% inflicted damage.
8) Slayer - at expert level it is a mass spell with bonus increased to +10 attack.
9) Counterstrike, Clone - spell cost decreased.
10) Sacrifice - effect increased by 20%.
11) Magic Mirror - 65% chance to reflect a spell at expert level.
author: wnukos
